```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
outcomes <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
roster_pos <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
study_pop <- career_endings(outcomes, roster_pos) |>
  label_endings() |>
  filter(group != "Position not recorded")
state_fill <- ending_palette()
state_lab <- c(ending_labels(), playing = "Played on")
# Here the still-playing colour marks players who came back the next season.
names(state_fill)[names(state_fill) == "Still playing"] <- "Played on"
min_risk <- 30

# One set of chances per eligible season, and one set for every season.
by_season <- ending_multinom(study_pop)
pooled <- ending_multinom(study_pop, season_terms = FALSE)
# With a term per season the model is the Aalen-Johansen estimate.
aj <- ending_incidence(study_pop, by = NULL) |>
  inner_join(by_season, by = c("time", "state"))
stopifnot(max(abs(aj$estimate - aj$cumulative)) < 1e-3)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
shown <- by_season |>
  filter(n_risk >= min_risk) |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)),
    season = factor(
      sprintf("Eligible season %d\n%s at risk", time, fmt(n_risk)),
      rev(unique(sprintf("Eligible season %d\n%s at risk", time, fmt(n_risk))))
    )
  )
nfl <- shown |>
  filter(state %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa")) |>
  summarise(nfl = sum(chance), .by = c("season", "time"))

p <- shown |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "Eligible season %d: %s of the %s players still playing going into it %s",
      time,
      pct(chance),
      fmt(n_risk),
      if_else(
        state == "playing",
        "played on",
        paste("ended:", tolower(label))
      )
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(100 * chance, season, fill = label)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(time, state), group = label),
    width = 0.75,
    colour = "#9CA3AF",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = nfl,
    aes(x = 101, y = season, label = paste0(pct(nfl, 0), " NFL")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = "#111827"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_fill, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    limits = c(0, 124),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How each eligible season ends for the players still playing",
    subtitle = "Players still playing; label: NFL share",
    x = "Percent of players still playing",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.75)),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.9, "lines")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

card_thumbnail(
  p,
  "career-ending-chances-each-season",
  release = release,
  height = 7.5
)
card_interactive(p, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: same-every-season
model_lab <- c(
  by_season = "Estimated at each season",
  pooled = "Estimated across seasons"
)
compare <- bind_rows(
  mutate(by_season, model = "by_season"),
  mutate(pooled, model = "pooled")
) |>
  filter(state %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa"), n_risk >= min_risk) |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)),
    model = factor(model_lab[model], model_lab)
  )
# Name each line at its right end, so the legend is not needed to tell them apart.
line_ends <- compare |>
  filter(time == max(time)) |>
  mutate(
    each_season = model == model_lab[["by_season"]],
    end_label = if_else(each_season, "At each season", "Across seasons"),
    # Pull the two labels apart where the lines end close together.
    label_y = 100 * cumulative + if_else(each_season, 0.3, -0.3)
  )
p_compare <- compare |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, by eligible season %d: %s %s in total; each season %s of the players still playing are %s",
      model,
      time,
      pct(cumulative),
      tolower(label),
      pct(chance),
      if_else(state == "drafted", "drafted", "signed undrafted")
    ),
    tooltip = if_else(
      model == model_lab[["by_season"]],
      sprintf(
        "Estimated rate at each season (matches the observed), by eligible season %d: %s %s in total; in season %d, %s of the players still playing were %s",
        time,
        pct(cumulative),
        tolower(label),
        time,
        pct(chance),
        if_else(state == "drafted", "drafted", "signed undrafted")
      ),
      tooltip
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, 100 * cumulative, colour = label, linetype = model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(model, state)),
    size = 2.4
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = line_ends,
    aes(y = label_y, label = end_label),
    hjust = 0,
    nudge_x = 0.12,
    size = 4.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = state_fill, guide = "none") +
  # Each model's formula: the log odds of ending k rather than playing on.
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("solid", "22"),
    labels = c(
      expression(
        "Estimated rate at each season (y ~ season):" ~
          log ~ (p[k * "," * t] / p[0 * "," * t]) == alpha[k * "," * t]
      ),
      expression(
        "Estimated rate across seasons (y ~ 1):" ~
          log ~ (p[k * "," * t] / p[0 * "," * t]) == alpha[k]
      )
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~label) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = unique(compare$time),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.42))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative percent reaching the NFL each way, under each model",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Cumulative percent of eligible players",
    linetype = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "The rate at each season has one term per season, so it reproduces the observed percents exactly.\n",
      "Why they differ: the rate across seasons pools every season into one, but few players are drafted or signed\n",
      "in their first eligible season and most in the middle ones, so it runs high early and low later.\n",
      "p(k,t): chance of ending k in eligible season t; p(0,t): chance of playing on. ",
      "Seasons with fewer than ",
      min_risk,
      " players at risk are omitted."
    )
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = unit(2.5, "lines"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  ) +
  guides(linetype = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
card_interactive(p_compare, width_svg = 12, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-position
obs_group <- ending_incidence(mutate(study_pop, group = droplevels(group))) |>
  mutate(group = as.character(group))
est_group <- ending_multinom(study_pop, by = "group")
thin <- thin_position_groups(obs_group, horizon = 3L, min_risk = min_risk)
fit_lab <- c(
  observed = "Observed",
  estimated = "Estimated"
)
by_group <- bind_rows(
  transmute(
    obs_group,
    group,
    time,
    state,
    cumulative = estimate,
    n_risk,
    model = "observed"
  ),
  transmute(
    est_group,
    group,
    time,
    state,
    cumulative,
    n_risk,
    model = "estimated"
  )
) |>
  filter(
    state %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa"),
    time > 0,
    n_risk >= min_risk,
    !group %in% thin
  ) |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)),
    model = factor(fit_lab[model], fit_lab),
    group = factor(group, position_group_levels())
  )
worst <- by_group |>
  select(group, time, label, model, cumulative) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = cumulative) |>
  filter(!is.na(Observed), !is.na(Estimated)) |>
  slice_max(abs(Estimated - Observed), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
p_group <- by_group |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s by eligible season %d: %s %s (%s players at risk)",
      group,
      tolower(model),
      time,
      pct(cumulative),
      tolower(label),
      fmt(n_risk)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    time,
    100 * cumulative,
    colour = label,
    linetype = model,
    group = interaction(label, model)
  )) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, model, state)),
    size = 2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = state_fill) +
  # The observed curve, and the model with a term per season plus a shift
  # per position group that is the same in every season.
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("solid", "22"),
    labels = c(
      "Observed",
      expression(
        "Estimated (y ~ season + position group):" ~
          log ~ (p[k * "," * t * "," * g] / p[0 * "," * t * "," * g]) ==
          alpha[k * "," * t] + beta[k * "," * g]
      )
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(by_group$time)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative percent reaching the NFL by position group, observed and estimated",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Largest gap: %s points, %s %s by eligible season %d",
      fmt(100 * abs(worst$Estimated - worst$Observed), 1),
      tolower(worst$group),
      tolower(worst$label),
      worst$time
    ),
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Cumulative percent of eligible players",
    colour = NULL,
    linetype = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Why they differ: the position term shifts a group's odds of each ending by the same amount in every season,\n",
      "so the estimate follows the pooled timing, and a group whose endings come earlier or later than the rest drifts from it.\n",
      "p(k,t,g): chance of ending k in eligible season t for position group g; p(0,t,g): chance of playing on.\n",
      "Seasons with fewer than ",
      min_risk,
      " players at risk are omitted",
      if (length(thin)) {
        paste0(", as are ", paste(tolower(thin), collapse = ", "))
      } else {
        ""
      },
      "."
    )
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.key.width = unit(2.5, "lines"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
card_interactive(p_group, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 11)
```
